name: The Long Road
intro: There is nowhere to stay tonight, so how you sleep becomes the terrain.
outro: You wake on the road at an hour you chose, which has not happened in a while.

nodes.label: Dusk
nodes.text: The mountain is no closer than this morning. The light on it is already on.

nodes.label: Wind Down
nodes.text: The hour before sleep is the part of sleep you can actually control.

nodes.label: Make It Dark
nodes.text: Cold, dark, quiet. Two of the three will do.

nodes.label: Settle The Head
nodes.text: Whatever is looping in there, give it somewhere to go.

nodes.label: Actually Go To Bed
nodes.text: The whole day has been leading here and you knew it.

nodes.label: Morning On The Road
nodes.text: Frost on the pack. You feel, irritatingly, quite good.
